_about: Player abilities: what the spell bar and spellbook show, and the numbers each one runs on. Abilities with a `kind` are spells run by the generic spell engine (src/systems/spells.js; its top comment lists every kind and field); the rest have their own code. `cost` is what an ability spends ({mana: n}, or a class bar such as {resolve: n}, {energy: n}, {focus: n}); `gain` is what it gives ({combo: 1}). `spendsAll` spends all of one bar (at least 1). `applies` puts an aura on the target (slow, stun, sleep, damage taken or dealt); `follow` lands another ability's effect too; `inShadow` is the ability used instead while in Shadow; `loadouts` changes tuning by what you hold (Weapon Master); `stacks` grants a stacking buff. Which class has which ability is in archetypes.json.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.desc: Auto attack. Left-click an enemy (right-click with Classic controls, RT on a pad), or use any ability on it, and you swing at it each time your weapon is ready while it is in reach, until it falls or you pick another. Time between swings = weapon speed ÷ (1 + haste). The blow lands at the swing's impact frame, and only if the target is still in reach then. Dual wielding, each hand swings on its own clock at its weapon's speed; the off hand does half damage and never lands within 0.2 s of the main hand. Not on the spell bar.

abilities.name: Auto Shot
abilities.desc: Looses an arrow from your ranged weapon at your target whenever its timer is ready, while the target is beyond your melee reach. On the move too. Starts with auto attack.

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.desc: Fire while moving and mark your target with Aim for eight seconds.

forks.name: Exposing Shot
forks.text: The target is Exposed: it takes 8% more damage for 6 seconds.

forks.name: Lean Shot
forks.text: Costs 12 Focus instead of 20.

abilities.name: Venom Arrow
abilities.desc: An instant poisoned arrow: your target takes nature damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds (5 ticks of 30% of a bow shot). Using it again refreshes the poison. Needs a bow in your ranged slot and uses one arrow. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Shield Break
abilities.desc: Slam your shield down: strikes every enemy around you, knocks them back and interrupts ordinary attacks. Triggers the global cooldown. 4 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.desc: Rush toward an enemy and gain 15 Fury when you hit.

forks.name: Shoulder Charge
forks.text: Dazes for 2 seconds instead of 1.

forks.name: War Path
forks.text: Builds 30 Resolve instead of 15.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.desc: Brace against incoming blows. A shield reduces damage, one weapon can parry, and dual wielding guards against one hit.

forks.name: Iron Wall
forks.text: The guard lasts 1 second longer.

forks.name: Retaliation
forks.text: Bracing gives you 20 Resolve.

abilities.name: Hallowed Bolt
abilities.desc: Call down the old road's light on your target: a 1.6 second cast that hurls a bolt of holy fire. Moving interrupts the cast. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Spend 15 Fury to bleed a target for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Heavy Strike
abilities.desc: A committed weapon hit builds 16 Fury on contact. With two weapons, strike with both.

forks.name: Rending Strike
forks.text: Also leaves the target Bleeding (Rend).

forks.name: Sundering Strike
forks.text: The target is Sundered: it takes 10% more damage for 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.desc: Spend 30 Fury on a heavy blow that can interrupt an ordinary swing.

forks.name: Executioner
forks.text: 50% more damage to enemies below 35% health.

forks.name: Bonebreaker
forks.text: Stuns the target for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.desc: An instant flash of holy light on your target. Triggers the global cooldown. 6 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Hallowed Ground
abilities.desc: Consecrate the ground around you for 8 seconds. Every enemy standing in it burns each second, and while you stand in it you heal 2% of your health each second. Triggers the global cooldown. 15 second cooldown.

forks.name: Sanctuary
forks.text: Heals 3% of your health each second instead of 2%.

forks.name: Holy Fire
forks.text: Burns enemies for 50% more.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.desc: Spend 25 Fury to strike up to four enemies in front of you.

forks.name: Bleeding Edge
forks.text: Every enemy hit is left Bleeding (Rend).

forks.name: Wide Arc
forks.text: A 40 degree wider arc that reaches 0.6 metres further.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.desc: Gain 30 Fury immediately.

forks.name: Rallying Cry
forks.text: You are also Fortified while it lasts: 15% less damage taken.

forks.name: Blood Cry
forks.text: Raises your damage by 30% instead of 20%.

abilities.name: Set Camp
abilities.desc: Spend 3 seconds pitching a camp where you stand. Your spirit rises there if you fall, and resting beside it builds rested experience. Not with enemies close by. Moving interrupts it.

abilities.name: Return to Camp
abilities.desc: Spend 10 seconds gathering yourself, then step back to your camp, wherever it is. Not while fighting. Moving interrupts it. Once every 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Return Home
abilities.desc: Spend 10 seconds thinking of your bed, then step back to the inn you made your home (ask an innkeeper). Not while fighting. Moving interrupts it. Once every 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Fishing
abilities.desc: Cast your line into nearby water. When the bob dips, click it or use Interact to strike. The nearby prompt shows your current key. Needs a fishing rod on your tool belt.

abilities.name: Rebuke
abilities.desc: A word of command that breaks your target's spell or aimed shot, and stops it starting another for 3 seconds. Some attacks cannot be interrupted. Off the global cooldown. 10 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Cooking
abilities.desc: Open your cookbook: the recipes you know, what each needs and how many you can make. Cooking needs a fire close by: your camp or the inn's hearth.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.desc: Strike to build one combo point. In Shadow this slot becomes Ambush.

forks.name: Serrated Strike
forks.text: Also leaves the target Bleeding (Rend).

forks.name: Lightfoot
forks.text: Costs 30 Energy instead of 40.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.desc: Open from Shadow for heavy damage and three combo points on a hit.

abilities.name: Double Cut
abilities.desc: Cut with both weapons at once, spending all your combo points: 60% of normalised weapon damage, plus 50% for each point, with each hand. Poisoned targets take 30% more. Triggers the global cooldown.

enhanced.text: 10% more damage for each combo point.

forks.name: Assassinate
forks.text: 60% more damage to enemies below 30% health.

forks.name: Twin Fangs
forks.text: Poisoned targets take 60% more instead of 30%.

abilities.name: Poisoned Blade
abilities.desc: Strike to apply poison and build one combo point on a hit.

forks.name: Virulent
forks.text: When a Poisoned enemy dies, the poison jumps to the nearest enemy.

forks.name: Crippling Poison
forks.text: Poisoned enemies are also slowed by 30%.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.desc: Puts one enemy to sleep for 10 seconds. Any damage wakes it. Bosses cannot be slept: it fills their stagger bar instead. Triggers the global cooldown. 20 second cooldown.

forks.name: Deep Sleep
forks.text: Sleeps for 15 seconds.

forks.name: Drowse
forks.text: Reaches 10 metres.

abilities.name: Shadow
abilities.desc: Step into Shadow outside combat. In combat this slot becomes Vanish, with its own longer cooldown.

abilities.name: Guile
abilities.desc: The next 2 enemy attacks within 6 seconds miss you completely, even a Grave Slam. Off the global cooldown. 20 second cooldown.

forks.name: Evasion
forks.text: One more attack misses you.

forks.name: Long Guile
forks.text: Lasts 4 seconds longer.

abilities.name: Flaming Arrow
abilities.desc: Burn the target. Hitting an active tar pool ignites it, removing its slow and burning enemies within.

forks.name: Wildfire
forks.text: When a Burning enemy dies, the fire jumps to the nearest enemy.

forks.name: Pitch Arrow
forks.text: Burning enemies are also slowed by 25%.

abilities.name: Tar Trap
abilities.desc: Set a trap at your feet. The first enemy to spring it leaves a slowing pool you can ignite with Flaming Arrow.

enhanced.text: The tar pool is 1 metre wider.

forks.name: Sticky Tar
forks.text: Slows by 70% instead of 50%.

forks.name: More Snares
forks.text: Up to 3 traps at once.

abilities.name: Triple Shot
abilities.desc: Loose three arrows at once: your target and up to 2 enemies within 6 metres of it each take 80% of a bow shot. Needs a bow and uses one arrow. Triggers the global cooldown. 8 second cooldown.

forks.name: Fan of Arrows
forks.text: Up to 5 arrows.

forks.name: Fire Volley
forks.text: Every arrow sets its target Burning (Flaming Arrow).

abilities.name: Long Shot
abilities.desc: Stand still for a long draw. Consumes Aim on impact for 35% more damage.

forks.name: Deadeye
forks.text: Marked targets take 25% more instead of 15%.

forks.name: Pinning Shot
forks.text: Marked targets are also slowed by 50%.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.desc: Leap 8 metres back, away from your target (or from where you face). Off the global cooldown. 16 second cooldown.

forks.name: Long Leap
forks.text: Leaps 12 metres.

forks.name: Quick Recovery
forks.text: Cooldown 4 seconds shorter again.

abilities.name: Blight Bolt
abilities.desc: A 1.8 second cast that hurls a bolt of grave-rot at your target.

forks.name: Rotting Bolt
forks.text: Also afflicts the target with Rot.

forks.name: Hexing Bolt
forks.text: Also curses the target with Hex of Withering.

abilities.name: Rot
abilities.desc: Apply a damaging curse. Its ticks build Corruption, with diminishing gains across targets.

forks.name: Contagion
forks.text: When a Blighted enemy dies, the Rot jumps to the nearest enemy.

forks.name: Deep Rot
forks.text: Lasts 18 seconds.

abilities.name: Grave Bloom
abilities.desc: Seed an area that applies Rot to enemies standing in it.

forks.name: Choking Bloom
forks.text: Enemies inside are slowed by 30%.

forks.name: Lasting Bloom
forks.text: Lasts 3 seconds longer.

abilities.name: Hex of Withering
abilities.desc: Curse your target for 15 seconds: it deals 20% less damage and moves 30% slower. Triggers the global cooldown.

enhanced.text: Withering takes 30% off their damage instead of 20%.

forks.name: Hex of Frailty
forks.text: Withering targets also take 10% more damage.

forks.name: Binding Hex
forks.text: Slows by 50% instead of 30%.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.desc: Release your Corruption to heal and extend your active curses.

forks.name: Prolong
forks.text: Your Rot and curses last 8 seconds longer instead of 4.

forks.name: Swift Purge
forks.text: Cooldown 4 seconds shorter.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.desc: Channel damage into healing. Each successful pulse builds Corruption.

forks.name: Long Siphon
forks.text: Channels for 4.5 seconds.

forks.name: Quick Siphon
forks.text: Cooldown 4 seconds shorter.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.desc: Land a holy weapon hit to build one Conviction. Successful auto-attacks also build Conviction.

forks.name: Zealous
forks.text: Up to 5 Righteous stacks instead of 3.

forks.name: Searing Strike
forks.text: Also sets the target Burning (Light's Burn).

abilities.name: Light's Hammer
abilities.desc: Spend up to three Conviction on a heavy holy hit. Spend Reprisal for bonus damage. Full Reprisal guarantees a critical hit.

forks.name: Stunning Hammer
forks.text: Stuns the target for 1 second.

forks.name: Judgement
forks.text: The target is Judged: it takes 10% more damage for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Light's Burn
abilities.desc: Burning holy light from Light's Hammer: damage every second for 8 seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.desc: Spend up to three Conviction to burst around you. Spend Reprisal for bonus damage. Full Reprisal guarantees critical hits.

forks.name: Healing Storm
forks.text: Heals you 2% of your health for each enemy hit.

forks.name: Thundering Storm
forks.text: Interrupts casts and staggers harder.

abilities.name: Bring to Kneel
abilities.desc: Your target is slowed by 50% for 2 seconds, then stunned for 2 seconds. Bosses are not stunned: it fills their stagger bar instead. Triggers the global cooldown. 20 second cooldown.

forks.name: Long Kneel
forks.text: The stun lasts 3 seconds.

forks.name: Humbled
forks.text: Kneeling targets take 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Light Shield
abilities.desc: Spend up to three Conviction on a shield. Absorbing damage stores Reprisal for Hammer or Storm.

enhanced.text: Absorbs 30% of your health instead of 25%.

forks.name: Bastion
forks.text: Lasts 15 seconds.

forks.name: Radiance
forks.text: Cooldown 8 seconds shorter.

abilities.name: Mending Prayer
abilities.desc: Spend mana on a deliberate self-heal.

abilities.name: Quick Mend
abilities.desc: An instant self-heal that trades efficiency for speed.

abilities.name: Renewing Light
abilities.desc: Light settles on you and heals you every 3 seconds for 12 seconds. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Swift Renewal
abilities.desc: Consumes Renewing Light on you to heal at once for everything it had left, and a little more. Needs Renewing Light. 15 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Circle of Mending
abilities.desc: Hallow a circle on the ground for 10 seconds. While you stand in it you heal every second. Triggers the global cooldown. 30 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Radiant Nova
abilities.desc: Light bursts out from you: it heals you and burns every enemy within 6 metres. Triggers the global cooldown. 12 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Thorned Vow
abilities.desc: Swear a thorned vow: for 30 seconds every enemy that lands a blow on you takes holy damage back. Triggers the global cooldown. 60 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.desc: At 100 Fury, rampage for up to 10 seconds. Fury drains, and landed attacks extend the rampage by up to four seconds.

abilities.name: Twin Fang
abilities.desc: Strike with each weapon. Landing both halves the Fury cost of your next Flurry or Crosscut.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.desc: Spend 28 Fury for four alternating blows while moving at half speed. Press again to cancel.

abilities.name: Crosscut
abilities.desc: Spend 30 Fury to hit quickly with both weapons. Twin Fang can discount it.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.desc: Spin for up to three seconds, spending 8 Fury per pulse and moving slowly. Press again to cancel.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.desc: Disappear mid-fight. Enemies search briefly while your existing poison continues ticking.

abilities.name: Blade Venom
abilities.desc: A lingering poison applied by Poisoned Blade.

abilities.name: Assassinate
abilities.desc: Spend combo points for immediate damage. Deals 40% more against targets below 35% health.

abilities.name: Death Venom
abilities.desc: Spend combo points to intensify your poison and extend it briefly. Requires your poison on the target.

abilities.name: Crippling Sweep
abilities.desc: Slash every enemy around you with both blades, slowing them by 45% for five seconds and building one combo point. Does not stop you moving.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.desc: Throw down smoke that blocks enemy shots passing through it for five seconds.

abilities.name: Distract
abilities.desc: Turn an unaware enemy toward the point you aim at without breaking Shadow.

abilities.name: Silencing Blade
abilities.desc: Interrupt a nearby enemy cast and lock it out briefly.

abilities.name: Pinning Shot
abilities.desc: Root an ordinary enemy for two seconds.

abilities.name: Concussion Arrow
abilities.desc: Knock an ordinary enemy back, including into prepared ground.

abilities.name: Piercing Shot
abilities.desc: Shoot through your target and up to two enemies directly behind it.

abilities.name: Arrow Hail
abilities.desc: Loose a high volley at the ground you aim at: arrows rain on every enemy there for three seconds. Fire while moving; it never stops you.

enhanced.text: The hail lasts one second longer.

forks.name: Fire Hail
forks.text: Every enemy caught is set Burning (Flaming Arrow).

forks.name: Pinning Hail
forks.text: Enemies caught are slowed by 40% while the arrows fall.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.desc: Interrupt a cast with a shot at close range.

abilities.name: Tripwire
abilities.desc: Lay a tripwire that roots the first ordinary enemy to cross it.

abilities.name: Burning Tar
abilities.desc: An ignited pool burns instead of slowing.

abilities.name: Soul Ward
abilities.desc: Spend up to 40 Corruption to absorb damage while you hold your ground.

abilities.name: Erupt
abilities.desc: Spend 30 Corruption. Consume your Rot on nearby targets for a burst based on its remaining ticks, capped per enemy.

abilities.name: Reap
abilities.desc: Consume one target’s Rot to deal a capped burst based on its remaining damage.

abilities.name: Grasping Dead
abilities.desc: Hands grasp at enemies in a ground area and slow their advance.

abilities.name: Blood Pact
abilities.desc: Trade 12% of maximum health for eight seconds of 35% stronger life drains.

abilities.name: Dread
abilities.desc: Drive an ordinary enemy away for a short time.

abilities.name: Firebolt
abilities.desc: Cast a fire projectile. On hit, consume Chill to release a small steam burst.

enhanced.text: A quicker incantation reduces the cast by 0.15 seconds.

forks.name: Hotter Flame
forks.text: Firebolt gains 20% spell power scaling.

forks.name: Scorched
forks.text: Firebolt leaves the target Vulnerable, taking 8% more damage for four seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Lance
abilities.desc: Strike with a shard of frost and Chill the target, slowing it by 35%.

forks.name: Deep Chill
forks.text: Chill slows by 50% for seven seconds.

forks.name: Splinter
forks.text: Frost Lance gains 25% spell power scaling.

abilities.name: Stormfield
abilities.desc: Place a field that hits enemies with lightning every second.

forks.name: Gathering Storm
forks.text: Widen the field by one metre.

forks.name: Charged Ground
forks.text: Each pulse gains 20% spell power scaling, and the cast costs 32 mana.

abilities.name: Frost Ring
abilities.desc: Release a ring of frost that briefly roots nearby ordinary enemies.

forks.name: Wide Winter
forks.text: The ring reaches another metre.

forks.name: Quick Thaw
forks.text: A shorter one-second root reduces the cooldown by four seconds.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.desc: Blink toward your aim, stopping before solid obstacles or unsafe ground.

forks.name: Long Step
forks.text: Blink travels another two metres, stopping before obstacles.

forks.name: Light Foot
forks.text: Blink costs eight mana.

abilities.name: Arcane Ward
abilities.desc: Raise a ward that absorbs a portion of your maximum health in damage.

enhanced.text: The ward absorbs another 5% of maximum health.

forks.name: Lasting Ward
forks.text: The ward lasts twelve seconds.

forks.name: Stout Ward
forks.text: The ward absorbs another 10% maximum health, with a five-second longer cooldown.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.desc: Cast a fast and repeatable force projectile.

abilities.name: Echo Sigil
abilities.desc: Place a sigil. Cast your next eligible projectile nearby to repeat it once at 45% damage.

abilities.name: Force Wave
abilities.desc: Push ordinary nearby enemies away from you, including into a field.

abilities.name: Collapse Ward
abilities.desc: Consume your remaining Arcane Ward and turn its absorb value into a burst.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.desc: Mark an area and commit to a long cast. The meteor hits the marked ground when the cast completes.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.desc: Strike a target, then jump to up to two nearby enemies at reduced damage.
